title: Don’t miss this
text: Both the hot air balloon and the sailing were awesome. The balloon pilot was very knowledgeable and it was a beautiful ride. The sailing captain and his mate were great. Highly recommend both.
author: terrtorr3

title: Balloon and sailing.
text: Amazing experience with great people! Both, the balloon and the boat sailing were delicious experiences!
author: javierlE6125NJ

title: A dream
text:
Excellent service. The pilot was very attentive, the flight was very calm and safe. We loved the detail of the cava, passport and photographic report 😍
Also on the boat Francesc was attentive to everyone, there was no shortage of tapas and drinks at any time. A dream experience
author: blumeng2023

title: Love it!
text: Our hot air balloon and sailing adventure was amazing! The balloon ride offered stunning views to Montserrat, and the sailing trip was so peaceful. Both crews were friendly and knowledgeable, making it a perfect day of fun and relaxation. Highly recommended!
author: wanderlust_2831

title: Super recommended
text: It has been an amazing experience! We really enjoyed both the balloon ride and the boat ride. The staff is super friendly and attentive to the smallest details. Super recommended 😊
author: belengch2018
